title: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Look at the blocks on the board. They show 34. Counting 34 things one by one takes a long time. Counting in groups of 10 is quicker. The long sticks are tens. The small cubes are ones.

draw.text: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Now look at the 3D picture of base-ten blocks. You can see a thousand block, hundred blocks and ten sticks. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.

draw.text: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Look at one long stick. It is 10 small cubes joined together. We call it a ten. Can you hold up 10 fingers?
34 has 3 tens. Count the sticks in tens: 10, 20, 30. The 3 in 34 tells you how many tens. Count them with me.
Now add the ones: 4 small cubes. 30 and 4 make 34. The 4 in 34 tells you how many ones. Can you see the 3 tens and the 4 ones?
Now look at 43. It has the same digits, 4 and 3. But now there are 4 tens and 3 ones. The place of a digit changes how much it is worth. Today, build your age with sticks and cubes.

faq.a: Place value means a digit is worth different amounts depending on where it sits. In 34, the 3 means three tens, and the 4 means four ones.
A ten stick is ten small cubes joined in a line. It shows ten in one piece, so you can count in tens.
Ones are the single small cubes. In 34, there are four ones.
They use the same digits, but in different places. 34 is three tens and four ones. 43 is four tens and three ones, so it is bigger.

faq.q: Can I make my own place value blocks?
faq.a: Yes. Bundle ten straws or lolly sticks with a band to make a ten. Keep single straws loose as ones. A grown-up can help.
asks: How do I make tens at home?

facts: In 34, the digit 3 is worth 30 and the digit 4 is worth 4.

quiz.say: Look at the number 52. How many tens does it have?
quiz.why: The 5 in 52 is in the tens place. So 52 has 5 tens.

wrong.0: The 2 in 52 tells you the ones.
wrong.2: 52 is the whole number: 5 tens and 2 ones.

quiz.say: Priya has 4 ten sticks and 3 small cubes. What number does she make?

wrong.0: 7 counts each stick as 1, but each stick is 10.
